description_for_human: Catalogo verificato e generazione di prototipi XDCE.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to list verified XDCE components, ask structured catalog-backed requirement questions, generate canonical prototype JSON, and validate prototype documents. Never invent component IDs, variants, styles, sizes, states, or enum values.

functions.name: listComponents
functions.description: List verified XDCE components, properties, variants, constraints and provenance. Parse the JSON text in the result field.

functions.name: generatePrototype
functions.description: Serialize the complete request object as JSON text in requestJson. Parse the JSON text in result. If its status is needs-input, present its questions before calling again.

functions.name: validatePrototype
functions.description: Serialize the complete prototype as JSON text in prototypeJson and parse the JSON text returned in result.

conversation_starters.text: Crea una pagina di ricerca con input, pulsante e tabella.
